verdict.rationale: openhands-docs-8 explicitly describes a PR-review automation: watching for a configurable label, inspecting full PR context, and posting an AI review comment once per label event, which matches the core ask of automated AI-generated PR review. However, evidence only shows a single review comment triggered by a label event, not clearly 'every pull request' automatically nor inline (line-level) comments specifically. Missing for 10: confirmation of automatic triggering on every PR (vs. label-gated), evidence of inline/line-specific comments rather than a single summary comment, and independent/hands-on validation of this workflow.
